claim: initializeAccount's msg.sender == address(this) branch skips EVERY initialization guard (no transient-flag check, no relay signature, no !isInitialized() check), so an already-initialized account can be re-initialized at any time via a self-call through execute()/executeFromExecutor(), running an attacker-chosen bootstrap delegatecall in account storage context with no hook or registry checks. The relay branch was explicitly hardened against re-init (commit 0b64d29, 'relay can not re-initialize the account') and the PREP branch requires !isInitialized(), but the self-call branch has no equivalent guard, violating the one-time-initialization invariant. Precondition: the trigger requires a validated userOp whose validator permits a self-targeted execute() call, or an installed executor calling executeFromExecutor() with target == address(this); a pure owner-key account gains nothing beyond the owner's existing power, so exploitability depends on a limited-scope validator/executor permitting the self-call.

evidence: contracts/Nexus.sol:305-333: 'function initializeAccount(bytes calldata initData) external payable virtual { if (msg.sender != address(this)) { if (_amIERC7702()) { ... require(!isInitialized(), AccountAlreadyInitialized()); ... } else { Initializable.requireInitializable(); } } _initializeAccount(initData); }' — when msg.sender == address(this) the entire if-block is skipped and _initializeAccount runs unconditionally. contracts/Nexus.sol:336-353: '_initializeAccount' parses (bootstrap, bootstrapCall) from initData and runs '(bool success,) = bootstrap.delegatecall(bootstrapCall); require(success, ...); if (!_amIERC7702()) { require(isInitialized(), AccountNotInitialized()); }' — for an already-initialized non-7702 account isInitialized() is already true so the post-check cannot block re-init, and for 7702 accounts there is no post-check at all. Commit 0b64d29 ('fix relay reinit') added the !isInitialized() require ONLY inside the relay branch with the comment 'Means relay can not re-initialize the account'.
runtimeTrigger: 1) Account is fully initialized (proxy or 7702). 2) A limited-scope principal obtains one execution: either a userOp validated by a session/limited validator whose policy permits a call to the account itself, with callData = execute(CALLTYPE_SINGLE, encode(target=address(this), value=0, data=initializeAccount(abi.encode(attackerBootstrap, attackerBootstrapCall)))), or an installed executor calling executeFromExecutor with the same self-targeted payload. 3) ExecutionHelper CALLs address(this), so initializeAccount runs with msg.sender == address(this), skips all guards, and delegatecalls attackerBootstrap in account context: attackerBootstrapCall can overwrite any AccountStorage slot, install an attacker validator (no withRegistry/withHook, no ModuleInstalled event requirement, no module-type check), or replace the hook without the uninstall flow. 4) Account is fully taken over / storage-corrupted while every other init path (relay, classic, PREP) would have rejected the re-init.
